note: Egypt: a foreign musician performs on a performing licence from the Musicians Syndicate, which vets foreign artists before their performances and can revoke the licence (Scene Noise, on the Syndicate's announcement after it revoked a foreign artist's licence). Actors' and the Ministry of Manpower's own rules for foreign performers weren't found. No days of performing without the licence are named.

sources.title: Scene Noise, Egypt's Music Syndicate Launches Unit to Investigate Foreign Artists
sources.said: The Musicians Syndicate in Egypt will establish a specialised committee to investigate foreign artists prior to their performances in the country. ... the Egyptian Musicians Syndicate revoked the artist's performing license,
